evals.name: concept-with-codebase-grounding
evals.prompt: Can you explain how the outbox pattern works? I've heard of it but never really understood why you'd use it instead of just publishing events directly.
evals.expected_output: Should build mental model of outbox pattern, find real examples in the declaration monorepo, walk through actual code with file:line citations, and include all three mandatory sections (Underlying principles, System design angle, What to take away).

evals.name: code-review-as-learning
evals.prompt: I'm trying to understand aggregate design in DDD. Can you find an aggregate in this codebase and walk me through why it was designed that way? I want to understand what makes a good aggregate boundary.
evals.expected_output: Should search the codebase for a real aggregate, explain Vernon's 4 rules using the real example, cite file:line, connect to domain context, and include the mandatory sections.

evals.name: short-conceptual-question
evals.prompt: What's the difference between a value object and an entity? Keep it short.
evals.expected_output: Should respect 'keep it short' but still include the three mandatory sections (even if brief), use a clear analogy, and ideally ground in a real codebase example.
